mapper.select: select * from user where login_id=#{loginId} and withdrawal_at is null
mapper.update: update user set last_login_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}

update user set name=#{name},email=#{email},nickname=#{nickname},birth_date=#{birthDate},phone=#{phone}, account_updated_at=case when account_created_at is not null and not (bank_name <=> #{bankName} and account_number <=> #{accountNumber} and account_holder <=> #{accountHolder}) then now() else account_updated_at end, account_created_at=case when account_created_at is null and #{accountNumber} is not null then now() else account_created_at end, bank_name=#{bankName},account_number=#{accountNumber},account_holder=#{accountHolder},updated_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}

update user set profile_image=nullif(#{profileImage},''), preferred_region1=#{preferredRegion1},preferred_region2=#{preferredRegion2},preferred_region3=#{preferredRegion3}, preferred_sport1=#{preferredSport1},preferred_sport2=#{preferredSport2},preferred_sport3=#{preferredSport3}, soccer_skill=#{soccerSkill},basketball_skill=#{basketballSkill},tennis_skill=#{tennisSkill},badminton_skill=#{badmintonSkill},bio=#{bio},profile_updated_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}

update user u set u.withdrawal_at=now() where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.withdrawal_at is null and not exists (select 1 from personal_settlement ps where ps.user_id = u.user_id and ps.settlement_status='정산대기') and not exists (select 1 from team_settlement ts where ts.user_id = u.user_id and ts.settlement_status='정산대기')
mapper.select: select u.user_id,u.profile_image,u.nickname,u.preferred_region1,u.preferred_region2,u.preferred_region3, u.preferred_sport1,u.preferred_sport2,u.preferred_sport3,u.bio, u.soccer_skill,u.basketball_skill,u.tennis_skill,u.badminton_skill, (select ifnull(round(avg(ur.score),1),0) from user_rating ur where ur.receiver_user_id = u.user_id) as score, (select count(*) from user_rating ur where ur.receiver_user_id = u.user_id) as rating_cnt from user u where u.user_id=#{userId}

select t.team_id,t.team_name,t.profile_image as team_image,t.sport as team_sport from team_user tu join team t on(tu.team_id=t.team_id) where tu.user_id=#{userId} and ifnull(tu.withdrawn, 0)=0 and ifnull(t.deleted, 0)=0 order by t.team_name
select back_name, account_number, account_holder from user where user_id=#{userId}
mapper.sql: select 'PERSONAL' as matchType,pp.payment_id as paymentId,pp.payment_key as paymentKey, pp.order_name as orderName,pp.payment_method as paymentMethod,pp.total_amount as totalAmount, pp.card_company as cardCompany,pp.card_number as cardNumber,pp.easy_payment_provider as easyPaymentProvider, pp.receipt_url as receiptUrl,pp.approved_at as approvedAt,date_format(pp.approved_at, '%Y.%m.%d') as payDate, date_format(pp.approved_at, '%H:%i') as payTime, case when pp.payment_status in ('CANCELED','PARTIAL_CANCELED') then 1 else 0 end as refunded, case when pp.payment_status in ('CANCELED','PARTIAL_CANCELED') then pp.total_amount - ifnull(pp.balance, 0) else 0 end as refundAmount, date_format(p.cancelled_at, '%c/%e') as cancelDate,m.participation_fee as participationFee, m.fee as fee, concat(month(m.match_date), '/', day(m.match_date), ' (', elt(dayofweek(m.match_date), '일','월','화','수','목','금','토'), ') ', date_format(m.start_time, '%H:%i')) as matchSchedule, concat_ws(' ', m.region, m.place_name) as matchPlace from personal_payment pp join personal_match_participant p on (p.payment_id = pp.payment_id) join personal_match m on (m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id) where p.user_id = #{userId} union all select 'TEAM' as matchType,tp.payment_id,tp.payment_key,tp.order_name,tp.payment_method, tp.total_amount,tp.card_company,tp.card_number,tp.easy_payment_provider,tp.receipt_url, tp.approved_at,date_format(tp.approved_at, '%Y.%m.%d'),date_format(tp.approved_at, '%H:%i'), case when tp.payment_status in ('CANCELED','PARTIAL_CANCELED') then 1 else 0 end, case when tp.payment_status in ('CANCELED','PARTIAL_CANCELED') then tp.total_amount - ifnull(tp.balance, 0) else 0 end, date_format(p.cancelled_at, '%c/%e'),m.participation_fee,m.fee, concat(month(m.match_date), '/', day(m.match_date), ' (', elt(dayofweek(m.match_date), '일','월','화','수','목','금','토'), ') ', date_format(m.start_time, '%H:%i')), concat_ws(' ', m.region, m.place_name) from team_payment tp join team_match_participant p on (p.payment_id = tp.payment_id) join team_match m on (m.team_match_id = p.team_match_id) where p.user_id = #{userId}

where h.approvedAt >= #{startDate}
and h.orderName like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.select:
select h.* from () h
order by h.approvedAt desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) as total, ifnull(sum(case when h.refunded = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paid, ifnull(sum(case when h.refunded = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as refund from () h
